description: Ministry of Tourism and Lands - Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005 order under Section 26(1) (Declaration of the Area in Badulla District as a Tourist Development Area)
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands) and detailed portfolio responsibilities (exercising powers under the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005 to declare a Tourism Development Area). The content includes both the "who" (government person) and "what" (specific government responsibilities and actions), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
